sources.name: Elejandría
findings: Site declares Spanish public domain or open licenses; not a work-by-work legal verification.
Section 13 restricts commercial reuse of own resources and provides an authorization route for noncommercial/educational uses.

sources.name: Textos.info
findings: Mixed public domain, Creative Commons/GPL/copyleft and specific publication permissions.
Free reading/downloading is not a blanket license for model training.
Conditions-of-use link points to an under-construction page at review time.

sources.name: Open Library
findings: Database rights statement does not clear rights in book content or all territories.
Borrowed/restricted books are excluded from content acquisition.
Use APIs for limited lookups and dumps for bulk metadata; no HTML harvesting.

sources.name: Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes
findings: Portal includes copyrighted works made accessible by permission.
Legal notice claims rights in digital editions and database, including editions of public-domain works.
Personal/private access does not provide a blanket training or bulk reuse authorization.

limitations: Source incorporation does not admit any book for training.
Literature can diversify genres without providing contemporary conversational or scientific coverage.
